description:
Here are the descriptions of the plots in Figure 4.1, following your guidelines:

**Plot 1 (Top Left)**

This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and WER (Word Error Rate) for different configurations of the Whisper fine-tuning model. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, is linear, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, is linear, ranges from 40 to 70, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue solid line, representing “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”, begins at approximately 66 and decreases to approximately 50. A green dashed line, representing “tiny full”, begins at approximately 62 and decreases to approximately 45. A red dotted line, representing “tiny int8”, begins at approximately 64 and decreases to approximately 48. 

**Plot 2 (Top Right)**

This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and WER (Word Error Rate) for different configurations of the Whisper fine-tuning model. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, is linear, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, is linear, ranges from 20 to 60, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue solid line, representing “base AdaLoRA_int8”, begins at approximately 55 and decreases to approximately 30. A green dashed line, representing “base full”, begins at approximately 52 and decreases to approximately 25. A red dotted line, representing “base int8”, begins at approximately 54 and decreases to approximately 32.

**Plot 3 (Bottom Left)**

This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and WER (Word Error Rate) for different configurations of the Whisper fine-tuning model. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, is linear, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, is linear, ranges from 20 to 45, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. A green dashed line, representing “small AdaLoRA_int8”, begins at approximately 40 and decreases to approximately 25. A red dotted line, representing “small int8”, begins at approximately 38 and decreases to approximately 23. A blue solid line, representing “small full”, begins at approximately 42 and decreases to approximately 28.

**Plot 4 (Bottom Right)**

This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and WER (Word Error Rate) for different configurations of the Whisper fine-tuning model. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, is linear, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, is linear, ranges from 10 to 30, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. A red dotted line, representing “large AdaLoRA_int8”, begins at approximately 28 and decreases to approximately 15. A blue solid line, representing “large AdaLoRA_int8”, begins at approximately 25 and decreases to approximately 12. A green dashed line, representing “large int8”, begins at approximately 27 and decreases to approximately 18.
